@@ -0,0 +1,385 @@
+"""
+Safe image loading utilities with SSRF protection.
+
+Loads images only from:
+- inline ``data:image/...`` URLs,
+- configured object storage (relative keys or ``settings.STORAGE_HOST`` URLs), or
+- external ``http://`` / ``https://`` URLs whose resolved IPs are all globally
+  routable public addresses (pinned at connect time, with redirects re-validated).
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import base64
+import binascii
+import io
+import ipaddress
+import socket
+import urllib.parse
+from typing import Optional
+
+import requests
+from PIL import Image
+
+from app.core.config import settings
+from app.core.logging import get_logger
+from app.services.storage import storage
+
+logger = get_logger(__name__)
+
+_MAX_REDIRECTS = 3
+_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT = 10
+_DEFAULT_MAX_BYTES = 20 * 1024 * 1024  # 20 MB
+
+_BLOCKED_HOSTNAMES = frozenset({
+    "localhost",
+    "localhost.localdomain",
+    "metadata",
+    "metadata.google.internal",
+    "instance-data",
+})
+
+_BLOCKED_HOST_SUFFIXES = (
+    ".localhost",
+    ".local",
+    ".internal",
+    ".arpa",
+)
+
+_BLOCKED_IPV4_NETWORKS = (
+    ipaddress.IPv4Network("0.0.0.0/8"),
+    ipaddress.IPv4Network("10.0.0.0/8"),
+    ipaddress.IPv4Network("100.64.0.0/10"),
+    ipaddress.IPv4Network("127.0.0.0/8"),
+    ipaddress.IPv4Network("169.254.0.0/16"),
+    ipaddress.IPv4Network("172.16.0.0/12"),
+    ipaddress.IPv4Network("192.0.0.0/24"),
+    ipaddress.IPv4Network("192.0.2.0/24"),
+    ipaddress.IPv4Network("192.168.0.0/16"),
+    ipaddress.IPv4Network("198.18.0.0/15"),
+    ipaddress.IPv4Network("198.51.100.0/24"),
+    ipaddress.IPv4Network("203.0.113.0/24"),
+    ipaddress.IPv4Network("224.0.0.0/4"),
+    ipaddress.IPv4Network("240.0.0.0/4"),
+)
+
+_BLOCKED_IPV6_NETWORKS = (
+    ipaddress.IPv6Network("::1/128"),
+    ipaddress.IPv6Network("::/128"),
+    ipaddress.IPv6Network("64:ff9b::/96"),
+    ipaddress.IPv6Network("64:ff9b:1::/48"),
+    ipaddress.IPv6Network("fc00::/7"),
+    ipaddress.IPv6Network("fe80::/10"),
+    ipaddress.IPv6Network("ff00::/8"),
+)
+
+
+class UnsafeImageUrlError(ValueError):
+    """Raised when an image source or URL is disallowed by SSRF policy."""
+
+
+def _is_public_ip_obj(ip: ipaddress.IPv4Address | ipaddress.IPv6Address) -> bool:
+    if isinstance(ip, ipaddress.IPv6Address):
+        if ip.ipv4_mapped is not None:
+            return _is_public_ip_obj(ip.ipv4_mapped)
+        if ip.sixtofour is not None and not _is_public_ip_obj(ip.sixtofour):
+            return False
+        if ip.teredo is not None:
+            client, server = ip.teredo
+            if not (_is_public_ip_obj(client) and _is_public_ip_obj(server)):
+                return False
+        if ip.is_site_local or any(ip in net for net in _BLOCKED_IPV6_NETWORKS):
+            return False
+    else:
+        if any(ip in net for net in _BLOCKED_IPV4_NETWORKS):
+            return False
+
+    return bool(
+        ip.is_global
+        and not ip.is_private
+        and not ip.is_loopback
+        and not ip.is_link_local
+        and not ip.is_multicast
+        and not ip.is_reserved
+        and not ip.is_unspecified
+    )
+
+
+def _is_public_ip_str(ip_str: str) -> bool:
+    if "%" in ip_str:
+        return False
+    try:
+        ip = ipaddress.ip_address(ip_str)
+    except ValueError:
+        return False
+    return _is_public_ip_obj(ip)
+
+
+def _is_safe_relative_storage_path(rel_path: str) -> bool:
+    if not rel_path or rel_path.startswith("/") or "\\" in rel_path or "\x00" in rel_path:
+        return False
+    if any(ch in rel_path for ch in ("?", "#", ":")):
+        return False
+    if any(ord(ch) < 32 or ord(ch) == 127 for ch in rel_path):
+        return False
+    segments = rel_path.split("/")
+    return all(seg not in ("", ".", "..") for seg in segments)
+
+
+def _extract_storage_relative_path(source: str) -> Optional[str]:
+    """Return the relative storage key if ``source`` refers to our object storage."""
+    if source.startswith("//") or "\\" in source or "\x00" in source:
+        raise UnsafeImageUrlError("Disallowed image path")
+
+    parts = urllib.parse.urlsplit(source)
+
+    if not parts.scheme and not parts.netloc:
+        if parts.query or parts.fragment:
+            raise UnsafeImageUrlError("Disallowed query or fragment in storage path")
+        rel = parts.path.lstrip("/") if parts.path.startswith("/") else parts.path
+        if not _is_safe_relative_storage_path(rel):
+            raise UnsafeImageUrlError("Invalid relative storage path")
+        return rel
+
+    storage_host = (settings.STORAGE_HOST or "").strip()
+    if not storage_host:
+        return None
+
+    storage_parts = urllib.parse.urlsplit(storage_host)
+    if (
+        parts.scheme.lower() == storage_parts.scheme.lower()
+        and parts.netloc.lower() == storage_parts.netloc.lower()
+    ):
+        if parts.username is not None or parts.password is not None:
+            raise UnsafeImageUrlError("Credentials in URL are not allowed")
+        base_path = storage_parts.path.rstrip("/")
+        prefix = f"{base_path}/" if base_path else "/"
+        if parts.path.startswith(prefix) and not parts.query and not parts.fragment:
+            rel = parts.path[len(prefix):]
+            if not _is_safe_relative_storage_path(rel):
+                raise UnsafeImageUrlError("Invalid storage object path")
+            return rel
+
+    return None
+
+
+def _validate_external_url(url: str) -> tuple[str, str, int, str, str]:
+    """
+    Validate an external HTTP(S) URL and resolve its public IP address.
+
+    Returns ``(scheme, norm_host, port, pinned_ip, host_header)``.
+    """
+    if any(ord(ch) < 32 or ord(ch) == 127 for ch in url) or "\\" in url:
+        raise UnsafeImageUrlError("Control characters or backslashes are not allowed in URL")
+
+    parts = urllib.parse.urlsplit(url)
+    scheme = parts.scheme.lower()
+    if scheme not in ("http", "https"):
+        raise UnsafeImageUrlError(f"Disallowed URL scheme: {scheme or 'none'}")
+
+    if parts.username is not None or parts.password is not None:
+        raise UnsafeImageUrlError("Userinfo in URL is not allowed")
+
+    hostname = parts.hostname
+    if not hostname or "%" in hostname:
+        raise UnsafeImageUrlError("Invalid hostname")
+
+    norm_host = hostname.rstrip(".").lower()
+    if (
+        not norm_host
+        or norm_host in _BLOCKED_HOSTNAMES
+        or norm_host.endswith(_BLOCKED_HOST_SUFFIXES)
+    ):
+        raise UnsafeImageUrlError(f"Disallowed internal hostname: {norm_host}")
+
+    try:
+        port = parts.port
+    except ValueError as exc:
+        raise UnsafeImageUrlError("Invalid port") from exc
+    if port is None:
+        port = 443 if scheme == "https" else 80
+    if not (1 <= port <= 65535):
+        raise UnsafeImageUrlError("Port out of range")
+
+    # Catch octal/hex/integer IPv4 forms (e.g. 0177.0.0.1, 0x7f000001, 2130706433)
+    # where platform getaddrinfo implementations may diverge.
+    try:
+        packed = socket.inet_aton(norm_host)
+        aton_ip = socket.inet_ntoa(packed)
+        if not _is_public_ip_str(aton_ip):
+            raise UnsafeImageUrlError(f"Disallowed non-public IP address: {aton_ip}")
+    except OSError:
+        pass
+
+    try:
+        addr_infos = socket.getaddrinfo(norm_host, port, type=socket.SOCK_STREAM)
+    except socket.gaierror as exc:
+        raise UnsafeImageUrlError(f"Could not resolve host: {norm_host}") from exc
+
+    if not addr_infos:
+        raise UnsafeImageUrlError(f"No addresses resolved for host: {norm_host}")
+
+    resolved_ips = []
+    for info in addr_infos:
+        ip_str = info[4][0]
+        if not _is_public_ip_str(ip_str):
+            raise UnsafeImageUrlError(f"Disallowed resolved IP address: {ip_str}")
+        resolved_ips.append(ip_str)
+
+    return scheme, norm_host, port, resolved_ips[0], parts.netloc
+
+
+class _PinnedHTTPAdapter(requests.adapters.HTTPAdapter):
+    """HTTPAdapter that pins TCP connections to a pre-validated IP address."""
+
+    def __init__(self, pinned_ip: str, original_hostname: str, *args, **kwargs):
+        self._pinned_ip = pinned_ip
+        self._original_hostname = original_hostname
+        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
+
+    def get_connection_with_tls_context(self, request, verify, proxies=None, cert=None):
+        host_params, pool_kwargs = self.build_connection_pool_key_attributes(
+            request, verify, cert
+        )
+        host_params["host"] = self._pinned_ip
+        if host_params.get("scheme") == "https":
+            pool_kwargs["server_hostname"] = self._original_hostname
+            pool_kwargs["assert_hostname"] = self._original_hostname
+        return self.poolmanager.connection_from_host(
+            **host_params, pool_kwargs=pool_kwargs
+        )
+
+
+def _decode_data_image_url(source: str) -> Optional[bytes]:
+    stripped = source.lstrip()
+    if not stripped.lower().startswith("data:image/"):
+        raise UnsafeImageUrlError("Only data:image/* data URLs are allowed")
+    if "," not in stripped:
+        return None
+    header, data_part = stripped.split(",", 1)
+    header_params = [seg.strip().lower() for seg in header.split(";")]
+    if "base64" in header_params:
+        if not data_part.strip():
+            return None
+        try:
+            return base64.b64decode(data_part, validate=False)
+        except (ValueError, binascii.Error):
+            return None
+    return urllib.parse.unquote_to_bytes(data_part)
+
+
+def _safe_http_get(url: str, *, timeout: int, max_bytes: int) -> Optional[bytes]:
+    current_url = url
+    for _ in range(_MAX_REDIRECTS + 1):
+        scheme, norm_host, _port, pinned_ip, host_header = _validate_external_url(current_url)
+
+        session = requests.Session()
+        session.trust_env = False
+        adapter = _PinnedHTTPAdapter(pinned_ip=pinned_ip, original_hostname=norm_host)
+        session.mount(f"{scheme}://", adapter)
+
+        try:
+            with session.get(
+                current_url,
+                headers={"Host": host_header},
+                timeout=timeout,
+                allow_redirects=False,
+                stream=True,
+            ) as resp:
+                if 300 <= resp.status_code < 400 and resp.headers.get("Location"):
+                    current_url = urllib.parse.urljoin(current_url, resp.headers["Location"])
+                    continue
+
+                if resp.status_code != 200:
+                    logger.warning("Failed to download external image", status_code=resp.status_code)
+                    return None
+
+                buf = io.BytesIO()
+                total = 0
+                for chunk in resp.iter_content(chunk_size=65536):
+                    if not chunk:
+                        continue
+                    total += len(chunk)
+                    if total > max_bytes:
+                        logger.warning("External image exceeded max size", max_bytes=max_bytes)
+                        return None
+                    buf.write(chunk)
+                return buf.getvalue()
+        finally:
+            session.close()
+
+    logger.warning("Too many redirects while downloading image")
+    return None
+
+
+def validate_image_source(source: Optional[str]) -> str:
+    """
+    Validate an image source without downloading it.
+
+    Returns one of ``"empty"``, ``"data"``, ``"storage"``, or ``"external"``.
+    Raises ``UnsafeImageUrlError`` if the source is disallowed.
+    """
+    if not source:
+        return "empty"
+
+    if source.lstrip().lower().startswith("data:"):
+        if not source.lstrip().lower().startswith("data:image/"):
+            raise UnsafeImageUrlError("Only data:image/* data URLs are allowed")
+        return "data"
+
+    if _extract_storage_relative_path(source) is not None:
+        return "storage"
+
+    _validate_external_url(source)
+    return "external"
+
+
+def load_image_bytes(
+    source: Optional[str],
+    *,
+    timeout: int = _DEFAULT_TIMEOUT,
+    max_bytes: int = _DEFAULT_MAX_BYTES,
+    raise_on_unsafe: bool = False,
+) -> Optional[bytes]:
+    """
+    Safely load image bytes from a data: URL, storage key/URL, or public HTTP(S) URL.
+    """
+    if not source:
+        return None
+
+    try:
+        if source.lstrip().lower().startswith("data:"):
+            return _decode_data_image_url(source)
+
+        rel_path = _extract_storage_relative_path(source)
+        if rel_path is not None:
+            return storage.download_image(rel_path)
+
+        return _safe_http_get(source, timeout=timeout, max_bytes=max_bytes)
+    except UnsafeImageUrlError as exc:
+        logger.warning("Blocked unsafe image URL", error=str(exc))
+        if raise_on_unsafe:
+            raise
+        return None
+    except Exception as exc:
+        logger.warning("Failed to load image", error=str(exc))
+        return None
+
+
+def load_image_pil(
+    source: Optional[str],
+    *,
+    timeout: int = _DEFAULT_TIMEOUT,
+    max_bytes: int = _DEFAULT_MAX_BYTES,
+    mode: Optional[str] = None,
+) -> Optional[Image.Image]:
+    """Safely load an image from ``source`` and open it as a PIL Image."""
+    img_bytes = load_image_bytes(source, timeout=timeout, max_bytes=max_bytes)
+    if not img_bytes:
+        return None
+    try:
+        img = Image.open(io.BytesIO(img_bytes))
+        return img.convert(mode) if mode else img
+    except Exception as exc:
+        logger.warning("Failed to decode PIL image", error=str(exc))
+        return None

+def test_dns_rebinding_and_redirect_ssrf_are_blocked(monkeypatch, internal_server):
+    port, hits = internal_server

+    # 1. Domain resolving to private/loopback IP must be blocked before connecting
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        socket,
+        "getaddrinfo",
+        lambda host, p, type=0: [(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM, 6, "", ("127.0.0.1", p))],
+    )
+    assert image_loader.load_image_bytes(f"http://rebind.example.com:{port}/secret") is None
+    assert hits == []
+
+    # 2. Public IP redirecting to internal IP must not follow redirect
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        socket,
+        "getaddrinfo",
+        lambda host, p, type=0: [
+            (
+                socket.AF_INET,
+                socket.SOCK_STREAM,
+                6,
+                "",
+                ("93.184.216.34" if host == "redirector.example.com" else "127.0.0.1", p),
+            )
+        ],
+    )
+
+    class FakeResp:
+        def __init__(self, status_code, headers=None, chunks=None):
+            self.status_code = status_code
+            self.headers = headers or {}
+            self._chunks = chunks or []
+
+        def iter_content(self, chunk_size=65536):
+            return iter(self._chunks)
+
+        def __enter__(self):
+            return self
+
+        def __exit__(self, *args):
+            return False
+
+    seen_requests = []
+
+    def fake_session_get(self, url, **kwargs):
+        seen_requests.append((url, kwargs.get("headers"), kwargs.get("allow_redirects")))
+        if "redirector.example.com" in url:
+            return FakeResp(302, headers={"Location": f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/secret"})
+        return FakeResp(200, chunks=[PNG])
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(requests.Session, "get", fake_session_get)
+
+    assert image_loader.load_image_bytes("https://redirector.example.com/start.png") is None
+    assert len(seen_requests) == 1
+    assert seen_requests[0][2] is False  # allow_redirects=False
+    assert hits == []
+
+    # 3. Legitimate public URL succeeds
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        socket,
+        "getaddrinfo",
+        lambda host, p, type=0: [(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM, 6, "", ("93.184.216.34", p))],
+    )
